ICS: Clarifies Patient Response  (summarizes, checks for accuracy)
Elicits all concerns  (provides support, identifies hidden concerns)
Respects Patient  (shows concern, acknowledges patient emotions)
Non-verbal Skills  (eye contact, body position, conveys interest)
Explain that your illness is directly related to smoking?
Advise you that quitting smoking can prevent worsening of the illness?
Warn you of short-term risks (cost, bad smell, cough)?
Warn you of long-term risks (heart disease, cancer, worsening lung disease)?
Explain causes and impact of COPD?
Advise that quitting is one of the most effective ways to prevent progression of COPD/other smoking related disease?
